cli.add_maintenance_tags_help: Faka iitemplate zokulungisa ezicetyiswayo ezivela kwiingxaki ezifunyenweyo.
cli.check_backlinks_help: Fumana amanqaku akhankanya eli nqaku kodwa angadibanisanga nalo.
cli.check_orphan_help: Jonga ukuba inqaku linamakhonkco e-wiki angenayo na.
cli.check_urls_help: Yenza uhlolo lwe-HEAD kwii-URL ezicatshuliweyo ukujonga amakhonkco angasebenziyo (kuyacotha).
cli.diff_help: Bonisa umahluko phakathi kwe-wikitext ephilayo neyalapha.
cli.dir_help: Skena zonke iifayile ezithi *-corrected.txt ne-*.wiki kuvimba weefayile.
cli.lang_help: Ikhowudi yolwimi ye-UI yemveliso ye-CLI neyengxelo (igqitha i-LC_ALL/LC_MESSAGES/LANG).
cli.maintenance_tag_help: Iithegi zokulungisa ezongezelelweyo; zahlulwe ngekhoma okanye zinokuphindwa.
cli.offline_help: Tsiba uhlolo lwamakhonkco abomvu nobukho bamacandelo.
cli.quiet_help: Cinezela imveliso engeyompazamo; ikhowudi yokuphuma kuphela.
cli.verbose_help: Shicilela kwi-stderr ukuba loluphi uhlolo oluqhubekayo.
cli.wikitext_file_help: Funda i-wikitext kwifayile yalapha endaweni ye-API.
